products.name: Enamel mug
products.description:
A camp mug in steel with a glass enamel coat. Holds 12 oz (< 350 ml).

Hand wash only. The rim is rolled, so it stays cool to the lip.

products.name: Field notebook
products.description: Forty-eight pages of dot grid, stitched, in a card cover that fits a back pocket.

products.name: Beeswax candle
products.description:
Poured by hand from local beeswax, with a cotton wick.
Small burns for about 20 hours, large for about 45.
